Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Rustic 8 Whale Print, Grey Frame, 30" x 42"
Colors: Multicolor
Materials: paper
This documentary-style print of eight different types of whales adds a natural touch to a nautical or rustic décor. A grey frame complements the its neutral colors. This print would be particularly at home in a man cave or on a fisherman's wall. 30"W x 42"H Print on paper in frame with grey finish A nature print ideal for a rustic style room or nautical décor Ready to hang, all hardware included
